title: Email to Doty about who wrote Serpo

tellings.quote: Dodie said, "I tip my hat off to you for realizing there was more people involved."

plain: A researcher named Deep Prasad says that in early 2020 he emailed Richard Doty, a retired Air Force special agent long tied to UFO stories, about Project Serpo, a story that spread online about a secret exchange in which Americans were said to have travelled to an alien planet. Prasad says he suggested that more than one person wrote it, and Doty replied, "I tip my hat off to you for realizing there was more people involved." If true, it would mean the Serpo story was a group effort rather than one person's work.
